user: close all my tabs except this one
content:
I don't have a tool that can enumerate or close other browser tabs — my toolset only lets me interact with the single active tab (navigate, click, type, etc.), not manage the tab list. So I can't close your other tabs for you.

To close all tabs except this one yourself, you can:
- **Right-click the tab** you want to keep → **"Close other tabs"** (Chrome/Edge/Firefox all have this).
- Or press **Ctrl+Shift+W** (Windows/Linux) / **Cmd+Shift+W** (Mac) — though note this closes the *current* window's tabs, so make sure the tab you want to keep is the active one first.

If you meant something else — like closing tabs within a specific site or a different action — let me know and I'll see what I can do.
